other_conditions: Applicant must have been born in Goa or have continuously resided in Goa for at least 15 years
Applicant must have secured admission to an institution recognized by the State or Central Government

Applicant must be pursuing one of the specified courses: Certificate Course in Home Nursing (minimum 6 months), Diploma in Home Nursing (minimum 1 year), Degree in Nursing (minimum 3 years), or Health Worker Course (minimum 1 year)
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend for the same course
benefits_summary: Covers course fees (up to ₹3,500–₹10,000), monthly maintenance allowance (₹300–₹800), and a one‑time amount for books/uniform (₹1,000–₹3,000)
